name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed

guaranteedRewards.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
tooltip: "Oats and grains specially mixed with the Argent Dawn's enriched manna biscuits."

narrative.details:
The Silver Hand thought me MAD when I told them that I could make a special horse feed that could nourish spiritual horses.  EVERYONE thought I was mad!  Well, now it's payback time!

I'll make what you need, PALADIN... so-called CHAMPION... but it will cost you.  I need special biscuits - Enriched Manna Biscuits sold only by the Argent Dawn - for this blend.  I also demand, yes DEMAND gold as compensation for the misery I have endured!

Show me the sacrifice you tout so much, PALADIN.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills.  The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
narrative.offerRewardText: YES, NOW WHO - wait - you're giving me the gold too? You weren't the one who called me mad (actually they called me a fruitcake nut-job)... still, you're willing to show sacrifice even for wrongs you've not committed?I... I misjudged you, adventurer.  Should you need more horse feed, come see me. I will give it to you free of charge. Thank you... noble champion.I am going to keep the money though - I'm not that much of a nut-job as to give up a fortune.
narrative.requestItemsText: Yes, I've proved you wrong now, haven't I? I've proved them all wrong! I WAS RIGHT ALL ALONG!!!

chain.subtitle: 8 quests at level 60, 16,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

quests.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer.

quests.name: To Show Due Judgment
quests.objectiveText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Exorcising Terrordale
quests.objectiveText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale.

quests.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

quests.name: Collection of Goods
quests.objectiveText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse.

quests.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
